title: Som Tam
paragraphs: Som Tam is a spicy green papaya salad from Thailand’s northeast (Isan), mixing shredded unripe papaya with chilies, lime, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Variations add dried shrimp, tomatoes, fermented fish sauce (pla ra), or salted crab. It’s crunchy, tangy, and a refreshing counterpoint to grilled meats.
